race.comment: DIRTY LOOK (7) won't want to give them too big a start but looks well placed to bounce back here. She had too much to do at Bendigo behind Alero who was very well ridden to the on-pace bias that day but she ran on well for second. Two wins prior, including one over this route rated well and she should go close. BAJARIA (8) is racing well for the Gelagotis yard who have been striking well recently. She won well here last time out and looks a big chance again. YOU SEXY THING (6) comes over from SA in good form off a win at Murray Bridge. She is 7 weeks between runs but can measure up. LOFT VEGA (9) resumes with a nice profile having won 2/3 to date and is worth keeping an eye on.
